summary: Full-scale quality audit of ServiceMarket. Tested all major flows: auth, homeowner, pro, admin, inbox, BIC auto-detect, tax/invoice toolkits, GDPR pages, mobile nav, notifications. Found and FIXED 2 critical bugs: (1) /api/messages/threads crashed with 500 due to invalid MongoDB ObjectId from 'pay-now-test' test thread; (2) PostJobPage navigated to dead-end /my-jobs route instead of /dashboard. All 57 backend tests pass (100%). All major frontend flows verified working.

minor.issue: KeyError '1' — DATEV quarter param must be 'Q1'/'Q2'/'Q3'/'Q4', not '1'/'2'. No frontend impact (frontend sends 'Q1' etc.) but could confuse API consumers. Consider adding a user-friendly error instead of 500.

ui_bugs.issue: Register tab 'Sign Up' link text is part of a <button data-testid='toggle-auth-mode'>, not a link — minor but affects automated selectors expecting <a>

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — likely from a Lucide icon accidentally rendered inside a <select><option>. Does not break functionality but triggers hydration mismatch warning in React.

bugs_fixed.issue: GET /api/messages/threads returned 500 for any user who had threads with invalid job_id ('pay-now-test' is not a valid MongoDB ObjectId). Fixed by wrapping ObjectId() calls in try-except to skip invalid threads.

After posting a job, the app navigated to '/my-jobs' which is not a registered route (catch-all → '/'). Changed navigate('/my-jobs') → navigate('/dashboard') to land on the correct Homeowner My Jobs page.

action_items: MINOR: Fix React hydration warning — find <span> incorrectly placed inside <option> element (likely in a Select component or MobileNav)
MINOR: DATEV endpoint — return 400 with helpful error message instead of 500 when quarter is not 'Q1'/'Q2'/'Q3'/'Q4' format
INFO: /api/auth/me returns 401 on initial page load (before auth) — this shows in browser console as error. Consider suppressing expected 401 at auth check time.
critical_code_review_comments: message_routes.py line ~49: ObjectId(thread['job_id']) crash — FIXED this iteration. Consider also adding validation in thread creation to prevent invalid job_ids from being stored.
PostJobPage.jsx: navigate('/my-jobs') pointed to non-existent route — FIXED this iteration. Search codebase for other hard-coded route strings that may not be in App.js routes.
tax_routes.py: DATEV endpoint crashes with KeyError when quarter param is not in 'Q1'/'Q4' format — should validate input and return 400 instead of 500.
AuthContext.js: Initial /api/auth/me call always shows 401 in console on unauthenticated load — suppress or handle gracefully to reduce console noise.
